blurb: Guests take guided bike tours through Pittsburgh's neighborhoods and river trails, learning about the city's history and landmarks. Tours are on flat terrain, suitable for all fitness levels, and include rental bikes and helmets. Children and dogs are welcome with conditions.
extraNote: Tours take place rain or shine except inclement weather · Free cancellations and full refunds up to 24 hours before tour · Cut-off time for most tours is 9 p.m. the evening before · 1049 Penn Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15222, on the side of the Convention Center, Downtown. · March through November, with possible rides on warmer days in December, January and February if conditions are safe.
